review:
Today i went with the wife and kid to Supreme Hibachi & Buffet in north babylon, NY, and i spent $65.41 (plus cash tip) for Three People.

Very very busy on a friday night. Nice fountain.

Plate #1
Goons (was goonin)
Baked clams
Smoked ribs
Boneless ribs
Bourbon chicken
Mac and cheese
Stuffed mushroom

Plate #2... .
Coconut shrimp
Grilled calamari
Pepper steak
Chicken n broccoli
And the fuckin pizza

Plate #3........
Chiness spaghetti
Various sushi
Seafood mix
Plantains

Plate #4..........
Banana pudding
Puff pastry with whipped cream
Fried apples
Tapioca
Rainbow cookie

Did this place deserve the 2.5* rating that they got on yelp? No. I think they deserved 4.1*

Didnt have anything that i didnt like. Everything for the most part tasted fresh. The coconut shrimp and sushi may have me sick later though.
